title_chain.zh_h1: 海因里希·阿格里帕·冯·内特斯海姆 Agrippa von Nettesheim, Heinrich Cornelius (Vittoria Perrone Compagni)

spot.html_text: Agrippa’s aim was to pass judgment on the condition, methods, and practitioners of the philosophical and theological schools which dominated his time. His verdict is undoubtedly very severe. He believed that contemporary culture, lost in useless sophisms, was no longer able to fulfill its task of educating Christian people and promoting their spiritual well-being.
